I saved this to the project's EngramDB memory store, which is what this repo's CLAUDE.md says to use. The rule is: all background jobs go through `jobs.enqueue()`, and nothing calls celery directly. That covers `.delay()`, `.apply_async()` and `send_task`. Future sessions in this project will see it.

I searched the repo and found no `enqueue` definition and no celery references yet. So `jobs.enqueue()` isn't in this codebase right now; it may be planned or live somewhere else.
